startup_fix.description: Remove FastNative from the Android Filament frame callback. Frame listeners can block in the native driver; normal JNI lets ART suspend the renderer for garbage collection.
startup_fix.diagnosis: The historical crash binary build ID matches the local native library; address 0x71e118 resolves to utils::Condition::wait_until. The Java frame callback used FastNative, which forbids blocking calls that prevent GC suspension.
startup_fix.compiled_and_installed: Compiled class has no FastNative annotation; installed APK SHA-256 matches the verified new build.

native_surface_fix.description: Retain the Android native Surface through Filament swapchain driver creation, queued destruction and flush.
native_surface_fix.build: Android arm64 debug APK built and installed successfully.
native_surface_fix.result: Deterministic queued-driver regression passed; surface mutex crash not observed after rebuild.
